decisions.reason: As a close-to-core design extension that remained prominently listed through 2024, it likely meets a satisfactory aspiration level and is cheap to carry within a broad drainage portfolio.

This product fits the firm's core competence and strategic push toward modern seamless bathrooms, and its continued dedicated presence suggests performance is at least satisfactory relative to aspirations.

Because it is a recent launch in a category where a similar 2023 pump-assisted product was already withdrawn, management would keep it for now as a problemistic-search successor but with a clearly higher risk of near-term discontinuation if results stay below aspiration.
